title: Proportion of Deliveries Paid by SHA
text:
AC3 · Monthly Trend Chart
Dual-line chart showing total deliveries (KHIS) vs SHA claimed deliveries over time. The shaded area between the lines represents the coverage gap. Outliers in KHIS data are winsorised to the nearest IQR fence before plotting.


Show code
# ── FRONTEND SPEC ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Line 1 (blue,  solid):  Total deliveries — KHIS (D)
# Line 2 (green, solid):  SHA claimed deliveries (N)
# Shaded area between Line 1 and Line 2: coverage gap (neutral fill)
# Reference line at 80% coverage threshold (optional, secondary y-axis)
# Tooltip on hover: Month | Total (D) | SHA (N) | Proportion | Gap
# X-axis: Monthly (MMM YYYY)
# Y-axis left: count
# Mark winsorised months with a distinct point shape (triangle)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

p_trend <- ggplot(monthly, aes(x = period_month)) +

  # Gap fill between the two series
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = sha_total, ymax = khis_total),
    fill  = pal$gap,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # KHIS total deliveries
  geom_line(
    aes(y = khis_total, colour = "Total Deliveries (KHIS)"),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = khis_total, colour = "Total Deliveries (KHIS)",
        shape = as.factor(outliers > 0),
        text  = glue(
          "Month: {month_lbl}\n",
          "Total (KHIS): {format(khis_total, big.mark=',')}\n",
          "SHA Claimed:  {format(sha_total,  big.mark=',')}\n",
          "Proportion:   {round(proportion*100,1)}%\n",
          "Gap:          {format(gap, big.mark=',')}\n",
          "{if_else(outliers>0, '⚠ KHIS outlier(s) winsorised', '')}"
        )
    ),
    size = 3, stroke = 1.2, fill = "white"
  ) +

  # SHA claimed deliveries
  geom_line(
    aes(y = sha_total, colour = "SHA Claimed (N)"),
    linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "solid"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = sha_total, colour = "SHA Claimed (N)"),
    size = 2.5
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Total Deliveries (KHIS)" = pal$primary,
               "SHA Claimed (N)"         = pal$accent),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = 21, "TRUE" = 24),   # 24 = triangle → outlier month
    labels = c("Normal", "Outlier winsorised"),
    name   = "KHIS data"
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b '%y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_comma(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Monthly Deliveries: KHIS Total vs SHA Claimed",
    subtitle = "Shaded area = coverage gap · ▲ = KHIS outlier winsorised to IQR fence",
    x = NULL, y = "Delivery Count"
  )

ggplotly(p_trend, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.18))

title: Proportion of Deliveries Paid by SHA
text:
AC2 · County Comparison Table


Show code
# ── FRONTEND SPEC ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Columns: County | KHIS Deliveries | SHA Claimed | Proportion
# Default sort: Proportion ASCENDING (lowest coverage first)
# Sortable by all columns (click header)
# Proportion column: colour-coded badge
#   🔴 Red   < 50 %
#   🟡 Amber 50 – 79 %
#   🟢 Green ≥ 80 %
# Counties with zero SHA claims MUST appear (left-join preserved)
# Table reacts to Date and County global filters
#
# ── BACKEND SPEC ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# GROUP BY county
# KHIS count : SUM of winsorised khis_count in filtered window
# SHA count  : SUM of sha_count in filtered window (0 if no claims)
# Proportion : sha_count / khis_count  (NULL-safe: 0 / 0 → 0)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

prop_badge <- function(val_pct, colour) {
  cls <- glue("badge-{colour}")
  glue('<span class="{cls}">{val_pct}%</span>')
}

county_tbl %>%
  mutate(prop_cell = map2_chr(prop_pct, prop_colour, prop_badge)) %>%
  select(
    County         = county,
    `KHIS Deliveries` = khis_count,
    `SHA Claimed`  = sha_count,
    `Proportion`   = prop_cell
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = md("**County-Level SHA Delivery Coverage**"),
    subtitle = glue("Period: {format(filter_date_min,'%b %Y')} – {format(filter_date_max,'%b %Y')} · Sorted by Proportion ↑")
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(`KHIS Deliveries`, `SHA Claimed`),
             decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) %>%
  fmt_markdown(columns = `Proportion`) %>%
  cols_align(align = "right",  columns = c(`KHIS Deliveries`, `SHA Claimed`)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = `Proportion`) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left",   columns = County) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = list(cell_fill(color = "#1A56DB"),
                     cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size                 = 13,
    heading.title.font.size         = 15,
    table.width                     = pct(100),
    table.border.top.color          = "transparent",
    table.border.bottom.color       = "transparent",
    row.striping.background_color   = "#F8F9FC",
    row.striping.include_table_body = TRUE
  ) %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote  = md("🔴 <50% · 🟡 50–79% · 🟢 ≥80% · Counties with zero SHA claims are included."),
    locations = cells_title(groups = "subtitle")
  )

2.1 Mathematical Definition
The indicator is calculated as:

\[Number = \frac{\sum(\text{Number of claims in ERP where status is unpaid})}{\sum(\text{Number})} \times 100\]


2.2 Logic Rules

Inclusion: Include only records where status = 'ACTIVE'.
Exclusion: Ignore test accounts (IDs starting with TEST_).
Null Handling: If denominator is 0, return null (not 0).

title: Claims Turnaround Time (TAT) Analytics
text:
AC2 · TAT Trend Over Time
The charts below show average TAT for claims that completed (received a paid date) within each period. Use the toggle to switch between weekly and monthly granularity.


Show code
# Weekly
weekly_tat <- paid_claims |>
  mutate(period = floor_date(paid_date, "week", week_start = 1)) |>
  group_by(period) |>
  summarise(
    avg_tat = mean(tat_days),
    med_tat = median(tat_days),
    n       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 5) |>
  mutate(granularity = "Weekly")

# Monthly
monthly_tat <- paid_claims |>
  mutate(period = floor_date(paid_date, "month")) |>
  group_by(period) |>
  summarise(
    avg_tat = mean(tat_days),
    med_tat = median(tat_days),
    n       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(granularity = "Monthly")



📅 Weekly📆 Monthly




Show code
p_week <- ggplot(weekly_tat, aes(x = period)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = avg_tat - 4, ymax = avg_tat + 4),
              fill = pal$primary, alpha = 0.10) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_tat, colour = "Mean TAT"),  linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = med_tat, colour = "Median TAT"), linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_tat, colour = "Mean TAT",
                 text = glue("Week: {format(period,'%d %b %Y')}\nMean TAT: {round(avg_tat,1)} days\nClaims: {n}")),
             size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, linetype = "dotted", colour = pal$red,
             linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = min(weekly_tat$period) + 3, y = 31.8,
           label = "30-day target", hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = pal$red) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Mean TAT" = pal$primary, "Median TAT" = pal$accent),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%d %b", date_breaks = "4 weeks") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .12)),
                     labels = \(x) paste0(x, "d")) +
  labs(title    = "Average TAT by Week",
       subtitle = "Jan – Dec 2024 · Plotted on paid date · Shaded band = ±4 days",
       x = NULL, y = "Avg TAT (days)")

ggplotly(p_week, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.15))










Show code
p_month <- ggplot(monthly_tat, aes(x = period)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = avg_tat,
               text = glue("{format(period,'%b %Y')}\nMean: {round(avg_tat,1)}d\nMedian: {round(med_tat,1)}d\nClaims: {n}")),
           fill = pal$primary, alpha = 0.75, width = 22) +
  geom_line(aes(y = avg_tat),  colour = pal$primary, linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = med_tat),  colour = pal$accent,  linewidth = 0.9, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_tat), colour = pal$primary, size = 3) +
  geom_point(aes(y = med_tat), colour = pal$accent,  size = 2.5, shape = 21,
             fill = "white", stroke = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(y = avg_tat, label = round(avg_tat, 1)),
            vjust = -0.9, size = 2.7, colour = pal$text) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, linetype = "dotted", colour = pal$red, linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = min(monthly_tat$period) + 5, y = 31.8,
           label = "30-day target", hjust = 0, size = 2.8, colour = pal$red) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b '%y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .15)),
                     labels = \(x) paste0(x, "d")) +
  labs(title    = "Average TAT by Month",
       subtitle = "Jan – Dec 2024 · Bars = mean · Dashed line = median · Label = mean days",
       x = NULL, y = "Avg TAT (days)")

ggplotly(p_month, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(showlegend = FALSE)
